messages:
Maria G: Quick heads up — we're kicking off a docs sweep next Tue to remove legacy v1 'invoke' param usage and to update model-swap + embed examples. Planning to batch small PRs and offer a docs bounty for quick fixes. :tada:
Samir: SGTM. Can you drop a short checklist? I'll own SDK snippet swaps (TS + Python). :white_check_mark:
Maria G: Checklist incoming. Keeping this thread for coordination and links so we don't scatter PRs.
Alex P: Should we target a soft freeze on new docs content on Mon so we can merge the fixes Tues?
Maria G: Yes — soft freeze Mon 16:00 UTC. Only bugfixes + migration snippets till Wed.
Lina: I can audit the code examples page and fix copy/paste issues. Where do we centralize redirects?
Samir: We'll update docs/redirects-map.json in the website repo. I can add an automated mapping script after PRs land.
Maria G: Checklist:
- find all instances of `invoke` + legacy params
- update SDK snippets (TS, Py, curl) to v2 semantics
- add redirect entries for removed doc slugs
- smoke-test examples (local and net)
- mark PRs with label `docs/deprecation-sweep`
- 1 reviewer from Docs and 1 from SDKs

Josh: Assigning owners: Samir -> SDK snippets; Lina -> examples audit; Alex -> redirects + net smoke tests; QA -> smoke test verification.
QA: We'll run the checklist against the staging site and verify code blocks execute. Add steps for token redaction in examples.
Samir: Example TS snippet to replace old `invoke` call with `responses.create` (draft):
```ts
// OLD (v1)
client.invoke({ model: 'r-instruct', prompt: 'Summarize' })

// NEW (v2)
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'r-instruct-2024-02',
  input: 'Summarize'
})
console.log(res.output[0].content[0].text)
```
Maria G: Nice. Add a short note about `output[0].content` shape and link to response schema.
Alex P: Redirect snippet we will add to docs/redirects-map.json:
```json
{
  "/docs/api/invoke": "/docs/reference/responses",
  "/docs/examples/model-swap": "/docs/guides/model-swap"
}
```
Lina: I'll run a grep for `invoke(` and `model: 'r-'` across `website/` and `examples/` and post hits here.
Lina: Found ~18 hits across MD and snippet JS. Posting PRs in small batches.
Maria G: Perfect — tag them with `docs/deprecation-sweep`. Also please add a short changelog blurb in each PR body: what changed + why + migration note.
docs-bot: New PR by Lina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/website/pull/8123 added (snippets + small copy fix). :robot_face:
Samir: I pushed a draft PR for SDK TS snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/421 (needs review)
Alex P: I've added redirect entries and a small script to validate mapping format. Script command: `node scripts/validate-redirects.js`
Maria G: QA — can you run the following smoke steps and report failures?
1) build site: `yarn build:site`
2) start local: `yarn start:site`
3) run snippet smoke: `npm run smoke:snippets` (this hits localhost:3000)
QA: Running now, will report back by EOD.
Josh: Incentive: small bounty — anyone who lands >=3 PRs this week gets a swag + $200 bonus. Please mark PRs with `bounty-eligible` label.
Alex P: Noted. Adding label to PR template.
Samir: One gotcha — `responses.create` returns structured content for tools and function calls. Make sure examples that assumed plain text are updated to handle arrays.
Maria G: Good call. Add a quick migration note snippet for plain-text users:
```md
If you previously read `result.text`, switch to
`result.output[0].content.find(c => c.type === 'output_text').text`
Or prefer the helper `utils.extractText(res)` (link to helper).
```
Lina: PR #8123 merged. Adjusting remaining snippets in followups.
docs-bot: PRs merged: 3; CI: passed; smoke tests queued.
QA: Smoke results: 2 JS snippets failed due to old `.text` access; filed issues #221/#222.
Samir: Fixing those in SDK PR now.
Maria G: Solid progress. Final checklist before Tue deployment: all PRs merged, redirects validated, smoke tests green, and a short deprecation notice in /docs/news. I'll draft notice and ping legal for wording.
Josh: Thanks team — great sprint. Will send bounty payouts after the final merge. :moneybag:
Maria G: I'll close this thread after deploy verification. Ping me if you need an owner swap.
